## Change

Describe the problem, resulting behavior/documentation and milestone.
Link affected requirements/ADRs where relevant.

## Verification

State checks, results and any checks not performed.

## Scope and review

- [ ] Consistent with charter; scope changes explicit.
- [ ] No real secrets, credentials or personal vault data.
- [ ] Relevant requirements, threat model, diagrams and ADRs updated.
- [ ] Claims match evidence; undecided choices explicit.
- [ ] Ready for review; merge requires approval.
